comments.author: @skatingcanuck9837
comments.text: Korean raw fish is called "Hoe" - pronounced hoo ehh. It is not sashimi. Hoe is prepared with a fish that is not killed until right before it's eaten.  It is served with a gochujang sauce and sometimes a sesame sauce. Japanese sashimi uses raw fish that is prepared with vinegar and possibly sugar, and  aged for couple of days or so. Hoe and sashimi have different preparations and different sauces.
